effects.name: merge-side-key-histories
effects.source: both stores' verified event chains and their replay provenance (D-38, D-41)
effects.capture: for each governed key (CI policy, anchor mode, tier, formal certificate, each NAME@VERSION open-in-CI exception), whether each side changed it since the common history, the command and resulting value of its latest independent write, and whether that write is shared with the other side; captured only in a refusal's detail

effects.name: target-store-concurrent-change-refusal
effects.system: the target (ours) Vouch store and, for merge-git-stages, the Git index
effects.detail: a divergent merge refuses with merge.conflict, writing nothing to either store or the Git index, when both sides changed the same governed key since their common history to different values, or when its replay would leave OURS with a value other than the one both sides already agree on; other merges write as before
